## Validation

- [ ] API tests pass for API changes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:visual`, and the relevant build mode pass.
- [ ] Browser tests pass for editor, import, long-roll, export, or mobile-layout changes.
- [ ] New fonts/data/assets include source, license, redistribution rights, and checksum.
- [ ] Generated, cache, runtime, and release artifacts are not committed unless the repository explicitly tracks them.
- [ ] Release-version changes update all platform manifests consistently.

## Compatibility

Describe effects on project JSON, IndexedDB/SQLite persistence, font manifests, feature cache, export ZIP layout, or platform packaging.
